about: The result file that the installer writes (--result) and the Hub of whichever version runs afterwards reads: a contract across versions, so every text is literal and the list only grows. `written` is what the installer writes for an outcome (scripts/tests/native-lifecycle/ContractTests.cs holds the installer to these texts byte for byte); `read` is what the Hub makes of a text while it runs `running` (CHATMCP-HUB/tests/verify-update-applied.mjs).

written.name: the old version could not be read
